reason: Qwen3 causal-LM generation on vLLM 0.16 / NxDI 0.10 does not produce valid text. Qwen3-8B at tp=2 crashes the engine core on the first generation step (REPORT S9). Qwen3-1.7B at tp=1 does NOT crash: it returns HTTP 200 with plausible throughput counters and emits garbage tokens.
ruled_out: raw-prompt formatting (completions and chat both degenerate)
model size (8B and 1.7B both fail, differently)
retrieval (retrieval-only probes are 7/7 on the same box)
NOT_ruled_out: tp=1 serving itself. Every good serving lane in this study ran tp=2. Rung 3 (Qwen2.5-1.5B at tp=1) is the control that separates architecture from topology.
why_it_matters: A silent wrong answer is worse than a crash. The 8B failure is loud and gets a receipt automatically; this one returns 200 OK and would ship.
correction: This receipt listed tp=1 serving as a live alternative explanation. The TinyLlama tp=1 control has since exonerated the topology: tp=1 is sound and the Qwen family is the broken variable. Kept for provenance; read the superseding receipt.
